hechos.consolidacion_recursos.model_impl: Household pantries and retail inventory become part of the common stock from the first days (day ~4). Rationing is centralized and efficient, with little household waste.
hechos.consolidacion_recursos.statement: The hive empties supermarkets, businesses and private homes to centralize food and medicine and distribute them.
hechos.conversion_inmunes.model_implicat: The number of the immune shrinks over time. In the game, the immune who are converted switch to the HDP diet and lose the ability to kill or harvest (the immune loophole).
hechos.conversion_inmunes.statement: The hive has figured out how to convert the immune with a custom virus made from stem cells, and it needs their consent. Kusimayu joins on day 71; for Carol they will use her frozen eggs, within 'a month, hopefully no more than two or three'.
hechos.convulsiones_globales.model_impli: Model 'convulsion events' as one-off mortality shocks: the first, calibrated, kills 11 million, about 0.15% of the population. With advance warning, lower lethality is to be expected. Each event adds bodies to the HDP stock and subtracts demand.
hechos.convulsiones_globales.statement: Intense negative emotions directed at the hive trigger worldwide convulsions. Carol caused two (day 1: 11 million dead; day 2 in Bilbao: no figure). On day 8 there was worldwide weeping over Zosia's thiopental, with no deaths reported. Manousos induced another by radio around day 60-61, with advance warning and no death toll.
hechos.cuerpos_union_recolectados.model_: Supports modeling an initial STOCK of bodies: 886.5 million from the Joining plus ~11 million from day 1, with a recovery rate and losses to decomposition. The canon doesn't explicitly say they are processed as HDP; the fan wiki says so ('stockpiled human corpses (those that perished in the Joining) for preservation').
hechos.cuerpos_union_recolectados.statem: After the Joining, the hive collects the corpses. In Tangier, Zosia loads bodies onto a truck headed for the airport, and the Agri-Jet refrigerated warehouse in Albuquerque is full of vacuum-sealed human parts.
hechos.estacion_union_pistas.model_impli: Suggests (without confirming it) a Joining in late spring or the northern summer, after May 8. For the default canon scenario, a date between May and July makes sense: before the northern wheat and corn harvest, when grain stocks are near their annual low. It should stay a lever.
hechos.estacion_union_pistas.statement: The canon gives neither the date nor the season of the Joining. There are clues: a bottle of water filled 'on May 8th' before the Joining; Carol on the verge of heat exhaustion on day 1 in Albuquerque; the Darién jungle at over 38 °C with 98% humidity (days ~20-40); fireworks for sale at a New Mexico gas station; a ski lodge with snow around days 61-74.
hechos.fuente_hdp.model_implication: HDP flow = daily deaths × recovery rate × kcal per body. With Cole 2017 that flow covers less than 1% of the stated 8–12%, so a stock of corpses (from the Joining and from the convulsions) is also needed.
hechos.fuente_hdp.statement: HDP comes from the ~100,000 people who die each day of natural causes and accidents; the hive presents it as using remains that 'would otherwise go to waste'.
hechos.ganado_liberado.model_implication: Livestock lever: canon = released, not fed grain, so no cereal stocks are used for feed. There is tension with the 'milking' in Cena's video; it's worth modeling two fractions (released vs. tended and milked). Natural deaths of released livestock are scattered, with lower carcass recovery; wolves compete for the carrion.
hechos.ganado_liberado.statement: When Kusimayu joins (day 71), the Peruvian villagers release their livestock and abandon the village. Wolves and 'buffalo' (bison) roam Albuquerque.
hechos.granjas_roboticas_no.model_implic: Automation is not a canon loophole: the hive's agency extends to its tools. If added to the game, it should be a 'non-canon' lever with relaxed strictness.
hechos.granjas_roboticas_no.statement: The immune pitched robotic farming, but the hive would have to build and program the robots, so the idea goes nowhere.
hechos.inconsistencia_hdp.model_implicat: The simulator should not fix HDP as a constant fraction of the diet. It should come from a stock (bodies from the Joining and the convulsions) and a flow (daily deaths, later starvation deaths), and the actual HDP fraction in the carton follows from the available supply. After the first few months HDP becomes marginal; that fits with 'even with the HDP, most… will starve'.
hechos.inconsistencia_hdp.statement: Derived check: at 125,822 edible kcal per body (Cole 2017), 100,000 daily deaths yield ~1.26e10 kcal/day, just 0.6–0.9% of the HDP needed for 8–12% of the diet of 7.348 billion people to be HDP (1.4e12–2.1e12 kcal/day). The 886.5 million bodies from the Joining (~1.1e14 kcal) would only cover 53–79 days of HDP at that proportion.
hechos.infeccion_gradual_previa.model_im: On day 0 practically all of humanity joins at the same time. The date of the Joining is the cutoff date for stocks and for the harvest calendar; the previous month did not alter food production.
hechos.infeccion_gradual_previa.statemen: Before the mass Joining, the hive spent about a month infecting people one at a time, thousands a day and with no deaths; when the military discovered it, it sped up the process with aircraft contrails.
hechos.infraestructura.model_implication: Refrigeration, logistics and water keep working (ep. 3: 'Water treatment, hospitals'; ep. 9: 'There's water and power'). Losses from lack of refrigeration should be low, with no logistical collapse; the constraint is supply, not distribution.
hechos.infraestructura.statement: Infrastructure is maintained selectively. Unneeded lights are turned off and no one works at night except in essential operations (water treatment, hospitals). They sleep together in stadiums, malls and churches to save electricity and gas. They use trains to distribute food, and drones, planes, phones, gas stations, water and power all work.
hechos.inmunes_pueden_matar.model_implic: Loophole for the game: only the immune (12-13 people) can harvest or slaughter. The hive would process whatever they obtain, but their physical capacity is irrelevant at a global scale.
hechos.inmunes_pueden_matar.statement: If one of the immune catches a fish or kills an animal, the hive mourns it but cooks it for them.
hechos.inmunes_sin_hdp.model_implication: The ~13 immune form a cohort with absolute priority over the highest-quality food. In calories it's negligible, but it matters for the game (Carol and Manousos).
hechos.inmunes_sin_hdp.statement: The immune are never served HDP; they get the freshest, best windfall and stockpiled foods.
hechos.lecherias_reconvertidas.model_imp: The drink is the main source of nourishment. However, Zosia eats omelets (ep. 8: 'We love all breakfast food'), so there is also some solid food consumption. It can be modeled as a drink/solids mix.
hechos.lecherias_reconvertidas.statement: Carol notices that the drink is made at the local dairy and assumes it's made at every available dairy or bottling plant; the Others drink it in large quantities.
hechos.linea_de_tiempo_t1.model_implicat: Season 1 covers only 74 days, so the simulator should show that stretch as a 'latent crisis' (deficit, no collapse) and project out to ~10 years. Days 48, 60, 71 and 74 are confirmed by The Ringer and Gizmodo; the rest comes from the fan wiki.
hechos.linea_de_tiempo_t1.statement: On-screen clocks, in time since the Joining: 11 h 26 min (Carol buries Helen and has her first outburst); 2 d 2 h (Bilbao); 3 d 3 h (flight to ABQ); 4 d 12 h (empty supermarket); 7 d 8 h (Please, Carol); 9 d 18 h (Manousos flashback); 12 d 20 h (ep. 7); 48 d (end of ep. 7); 60 d 16 h (Manousos arrives); 71 d (Kusimayu joins); 74 d (season finale).
hechos.mortalidad_abstinencia.model_impl: There is an additional source of early mortality (drug and alcohol withdrawal after the Joining) that feeds the flow of bodies. The canon doesn't quantify it.
hechos.mortalidad_abstinencia.statement: The hospital has 'a whole wing' of bodies recovering from physical addiction, and some might not make it.
hechos.nacimientos_continuan.model_impli: The 'births ON' lever is canon (~139,000/day). The implied mortality (~241,000/day) exceeds Cena's 100,000/day; the model can read it as rising mortality or use it as the slider's range.
hechos.nacimientos_continuan.statement: Births continue after the Joining: Zosia counts 965 births and 1,674 deaths in ten minutes, and accidents keep happening (a man impaled in Bulgaria).
hechos.no_matan_ni_para_inmunes.model_im: The preexisting stock of fresh or frozen meat and fish can be eaten, but it is perishable and takes priority (cold chain). There is no fishing or slaughter. Aquaculture and live livestock only become food through natural death.
hechos.no_matan_ni_para_inmunes.statemen: The hive won't kill even to serve the immune: there's no lobster because the only one available is live. It does serve chicken, fish and beef, 'the freshest we could find in the local markets', that is, preexisting meat. It says it would prefer to be vegetarian, and it doesn't kill snails, wasps or, on purpose, insects.
hechos.procesamiento_hdp.model_implicati: HDP goes through cold chain, grinding, cooking, drying to powder and reconstitution with water. Plant capacity and a processing loss can be modeled; the phrase 'three shifts a day' is only Carol's guess.
hechos.procesamiento_hdp.statement: HDP is processed in repurposed food plants. Agri-Jet (a refrigerated warehouse in Albuquerque) has bodies in vacuum-sealed pieces, a meat grinder 'the size of a bus' and cooking vats. Duke City Dairy mixes a crystalline powder with water and fills children's milk cartons.
hechos.proyeccion_hambre_colmena.model_i: Calibration target: in the canon scenario, more than 50% of the population starves to death within 10 years. Also, in ep. 6 Carol says 'They are choosing to starve' and in ep. 8 'You are starving', which implies a caloric deficit already present around days 12-55 (Cena: 'We're facing a caloric deficit').
hechos.proyeccion_hambre_colmena.stateme: Koumba: even with HDP, most of the world's population will starve to death within the next ten years, according to the hive itself when pressed.
hechos.proyecto_antena.model_implication: The hive doesn't devote all its capacity to food security: it diverts energy and labor. It's a qualitative factor that can be included as a logistical opportunity cost.
hechos.proyecto_antena.statement: The hive plans to build a giant antenna to transmit the signal to other planets; it rebuilt an entire diner for Carol and takes on other projects that consume labor and energy.
hechos.receta_bebida.model_implication: Canon consumption policy: most perishable first (FIFO by shelf life), turned into a stable product, which reduces spoilage losses. Distribution is modeled by region, with a local mix.
hechos.receta_bebida.statement: The drink is shelf-stable at room temperature, is made all over the world with a recipe that varies with local ingredients, and uses mostly stockpiled food, especially food that is about to spoil, plus 8–12% HDP.
hechos.regla_no_interferir_vida.model_im: New agricultural production is 0 by default ('canon' strictness level). With grain crops explicitly forbidden, the 'harvest dead crops after ripening' lever is a non-canon loophole and should be off by default.
hechos.regla_no_interferir_vida.statemen: The hive's core rule: they can't purposely kill, harm or otherwise 'interfere' with any form of life, plants included. They don't harvest wheat, corn or rice, and they don't pluck apples from trees.
hechos.regla_ordenio.model_implication: Milk is a permitted canon flow: the milk lever is ON by default, for animal welfare and not as a loophole. Future production depends on the cows surviving without harvested grain and on there being no new induced pregnancies (insemination would be 'interfering'), so it declines as lactation runs its course.
hechos.regla_ordenio.statement: They keep milking: the video says there are 'billions' of domesticated animals, mostly cows, that still require milking.
hechos.regla_windfall.model_implication: The flow of fallen fruit and nuts is canon and gathering aims for the maximum, so the windfall recovery rate should start high and be limited by logistics and spoilage. It is seasonal by hemisphere.
hechos.regla_windfall.statement: They can eat fruit that falls on its own ('windfall'), and they harvest all they can find.
hechos.stock_preexistente.model_implicat: The initial STOCKS are canon, but with no precise magnitude (the real figure for global cereal reserves, on the order of hundreds of Mt, comes from FAO/AMIS/USDA in another dimension). 'Processed prior' suggests also including stored grain and packaged food.
hechos.stock_preexistente.statement: There is preexisting food, 'millions of tons of it', processed before the Joining.
hechos.temporada2_estado.model_implicati: There's no new canon to incorporate. Parameters like the 10-year horizon could change with Season 2, so it's best to keep them as editable sliders.
hechos.temporada2_estado.statement: Season 2: filming scheduled for late October or early November 2026 in Albuquerque, a 10-episode order and a premiere expected between late 2027 and mid-2028. As of Sept 2026 there are no plot details about food, HDP or famine.
hechos.zoologicos_y_mascotas.model_impli: 'Pets/zoos' lever: canon = released, with a small fraction fed (ep. 8: 'when an animal refuses to leave its former owner's side, we take care of them'). Little animal demand on human reserves, and extra mortality from dangerous wildlife.
hechos.zoologicos_y_mascotas.statement: After the Joining every zoo was emptied and every chained dog was set loose; a giraffe eats leaves in Beijing, and there were 'quite a few maulings' by lions and tigers. The hive doesn't keep pets, but it cares for animals that refuse to leave their former owner.
nota: Values researched and verified against sources (FAO, USDA, UN, WHO, literature) plus the canon's numbers. The ranges are the ones explored as levers.
nota_ganado: Edible kcal = average live weight of the herd × kcal per live kg (carcass × meat energy). Feed = the grain each species eats today (1,122 Mt of cereal a year, split according to compound feed by sector), per head.
palancas.adaptacion_metabolica.descripci: How much the body's energy expenditure drops as its reserve runs out (less mass plus adaptive thermogenesis). Calibrated at 0.7 against the fasts of the 1981 hunger strikers, Minnesota and Leningrad.
palancas.cereal_en_mano_mt.descripcion: Cereal in storage on the day of the Joining. Empty = calculated from the month.
palancas.cosecha_senescente.descripcion: Gather grain from crops that were already planted once the plant dies on its own at maturity. Applies only to the first cycle.
palancas.declive_huerto_anual.descripcio: Annual yield decline of orchards without pruning, weeding or pest control (killing insects is forbidden too).
palancas.dias_inventario_cadena.descripc: Days of consumption held in stores, warehouses and pantries.
palancas.factor_otros_stocks.descripcion: Multiplier on soybeans, oilseeds, oils, sugar, legumes and tubers.
palancas.frac_conservacion_fruta.descrip: Fraction of windfall fruit that is dried or canned for later.
palancas.frac_recuperacion_cuerpos.descr: Fraction of bodies (from the Joining and afterwards) that are recovered and processed.
palancas.fruta_caida_factor.descripcion: Multiplier on recoverable fallen fruit and nuts.
palancas.ganado_politica.descripcion: release: livestock are set loose and die in the fields (little recoverable meat). feed: they keep being fed, with the same grain people eat.
palancas.horizonte_estirar_anios.descrip: How long the hive wants the food to last (stretch mode). Koumba talks about ten years.
palancas.kcal_dia_promedio.descripcion: Average energy requirement per person per day (whole population). At PAL 1.4 the hive saves energy; typical sedentary would be ~2,070 kcal. Note: John Cena's 2,400 kcal (~114 kg) are a deficit, not his requirement.
palancas.mascotas_politica.descripcion: Canon: they emptied the zoos and set the chained dogs loose; they only care for the ones that won't leave their owner. feed: keep feeding pets that had owners (~200 million dogs and 220 million cats).
palancas.mes_union.descripcion: Month in which the Joining happens. It determines how much grain was in storage: July 1 is the year's low (~1,385 Mt) and December 1 the high (~2,185 Mt). The canon gives no date, but the clues (a bottle filled on May 8, the heat on day 1 in Albuquerque) point to late spring or summer.
palancas.muertes_naturales_dia.descripci: Daily deaths from natural causes and accidents at the start: nearly 100,000 according to Cena; 241,000 according to Zosia's count in ep. 8. Scales with population.
palancas.natalidad.descripcion: Multiplier on the canon birth rate (965 births every 10 minutes, ep. 8) after the pregnancies already under way (first 9 months). 2.35 brings back the pre-Joining birth rate (16.1 per thousand).
palancas.ordena_leche.descripcion: Fraction of dairy cows that keep being milked. Canon: Cena's video says billions of domesticated animals, mostly cows, still require milking.
palancas.partos_ganado.descripcion: Let livestock keep giving birth. Without births, milk runs out when the current lactation ends (~10 months).
palancas.racion_fraccion.descripcion: Ration as a fraction of the requirement (fixed mode).
palancas.racion_minima.descripcion: Minimum ration the hive accepts when stretching.
palancas.racion_modo.descripcion: full: everyone eats what they need until it runs out. fixed: a constant ration. stretch: the hive works out the ration so the food lasts until the chosen horizon.
palancas.resquicio_huevos.descripcion: Fraction of previous egg production that is kept (requires fed hens).
palancas.resquicio_miel.descripcion: Fraction of previous honey production that is kept.
palancas.siembra_senescente.descripcion: Sow and gather only once the plant dies on its own, as a fraction of the normal harvest, from the second year on.
supuestos.aceites_mt.descripcion: Stored vegetable oils; with no biodiesel, all of it is food.
supuestos.adaptacion_metabolica.derivaci: Calibrated together with the reserve and the malnutrition risk: a lean hunger striker's total fast (~90,000 kcal) lasts ~67 days (observed: 46-73, average 62); at ~84% of the ration for 24 weeks, ~0.4% die (Minnesota: 0 in healthy men); at 30%, ~38% die in 24 weeks (Leningrad, with a worse official ration but informal supplements: ~25-30%).
supuestos.adaptacion_metabolica.descripc: Maximum drop in energy expenditure as the reserve runs out (less mass plus adaptive thermogenesis).
supuestos.almacen_frio_mt.descripcion: Food in the world's cold storage (the US holds 3.94 Mt).
supuestos.azucar_mt.descripcion: Stored sugar: USDA gives 43.5 Mt in ending stocks, the ISO ~79 Mt, and the annual average is around 100 Mt.
supuestos.cereal_produccion_mt.descripci: World cereal production in 2025 (USDA PSD; FAO: 3,043 Mt). Only counts if gathering grain from dead plants is allowed.
supuestos.declive_huerto_anual.descripci: Annual yield decline of orchards without pruning, weeding or pest control.
supuestos.dias_gestacion_vaca.descripcio: A cow's gestation: those already pregnant give birth over the following months even if no new births are allowed.
supuestos.dias_inventario_cadena.derivac: Excluding manufacturing, so as not to double-count raw materials already in the stocks.
supuestos.dias_inventario_cadena.descrip: Days of sales held in stores (~10), distribution (~15) and pantries (~7), which the hive centralizes from day 4.
supuestos.factor_cuerpo_hambre.derivacio: An emaciated body yields ~40,000-60,000 kcal versus 125,822.
supuestos.factor_cuerpo_hambre.descripci: Energy left in a body that died of starvation relative to a normal one: no fat and 40% less muscle.
supuestos.factor_cuerpo_mayores.descripc: Energy of an elderly person's body relative to an adult's.
supuestos.factor_cuerpo_ninos.derivacion: Children from the Joining, ~20 kg, versus the 66 kg reference.
supuestos.factor_cuerpo_ninos.descripcio: Energy of a child's body relative to an adult's.
supuestos.frac_cadena_perecedera.descrip: Perishable share (in calories) of that inventory: fruit, vegetables, dairy and meat.
supuestos.frac_cereal_comestible.descrip: Fraction of stored cereal fit for humans: feed grain is almost all edible, except what is damaged or contains mycotoxins.
supuestos.frac_conservacion_fruta.deriva: Canon: they first process what is about to spoil and turn it into a stable drink.
supuestos.frac_conservacion_fruta.descri: Fraction of windfall fruit that the hive dries, cans or presses instead of eating it fresh.
supuestos.frac_mayores.descripcion: Fraction of the population aged 65 or over (UN, WPP 2024, year 2025).
supuestos.frac_muertes_mayores.descripci: Fraction of natural deaths that are elderly (65+).
supuestos.frac_muertes_ninos.descripcion: Fraction of natural deaths that are children (0-14).
supuestos.frac_ninos.descripcion: Fraction of the population aged 0 to 14 (UN, WPP 2024, year 2025).
supuestos.frac_recuperacion_cadaver_alim: Meat recovered from animals that die on farms (found within hours).
supuestos.frac_recuperacion_cadaver_libe: Meat recovered from released animals that die in the open (scavengers, heat, disease).
supuestos.frac_recuperacion_cuerpos.deri: Canon: they collect corpses, and the Agri-Jet refrigerated warehouse is full of vacuum-sealed parts.
supuestos.frac_recuperacion_cuerpos.desc: Fraction of bodies that the hive recovers and processes.
supuestos.frac_vacas_prenadas.derivacion: With one calving every 12-13 months and 305 days of lactation, a little over half the herd is pregnant on any given day.
supuestos.frac_vacas_prenadas.descripcio: Fraction of dairy cows pregnant on the day of the Joining. Without new births, milk lasts ~19 months instead of ~10.
supuestos.fruta_caida_kcal_anio1.descrip: Recoverable fallen fruit and nuts in the first year (includes loose oil palm fruit; without palm it would be 1.83e14).
supuestos.huevo_kcal_anio.descripcion: Energy of world egg production (98 Mt × 1,290 kcal/kg in shell).
supuestos.kcal_cuerpo_adulto.descripcion: Edible energy of a 66 kg adult body (Cole 2017); with skeleton and skin, 143,771.
supuestos.kcal_dia_perro.descripcion: Requirement of an owned dog (~15 kg).
supuestos.kcal_dia_promedio.descripcion: Average energy requirement of the hive at low activity (PAL 1.4): it saves energy, sleeps together and turns off lights, but keeps the infrastructure running. Typical sedentary (PAL 1.55) would be ~2,070; active, ~2,379 (FAO ADER).
supuestos.kcal_kg_cereal.descripcion: Energy in stored cereal, weighted by stocks (wheat, corn, milled rice and minor grains).
supuestos.kcal_kg_congelados.descripcion: Average energy of frozen food (meat, poultry, cheese, butter, frozen vegetables and potatoes).
supuestos.kcal_kg_soya.descripcion: Energy in soybeans (they have to be cooked).
supuestos.kcal_suministro_previo.descrip: Food supply per person before the Joining (including waste): the rate at which those inventories were being emptied.
supuestos.leche_kcal_anio.descripcion: Energy of world milk production (971 Mt × 650 kcal/kg).
supuestos.legumbres_mt.descripcion: Stored dried legumes (there is no official global figure).
supuestos.masa_fallecido_promedio_kg.des: Average mass of those who die of natural causes (mostly the elderly).
supuestos.muertes_naturales_dia.descripc: Daily deaths from natural causes and accidents. Canon: 'nearly 100,000' (Cena); Zosia counts 1,674 in 10 minutes in ep. 8, i.e. 241,000 a day.
supuestos.natalidad_anual.descripcion: Birth rate. Canon: 965 births in 10 minutes (ep. 8), about 139,000 a day; before the Joining it was 16.1 per thousand.
supuestos.oleaginosas_otras_mt.derivacio: Ending stocks of 20.6 Mt plus the share of the year's harvests not yet consumed.
supuestos.oleaginosas_otras_mt.descripci: Rapeseed, sunflower seed, peanuts and other oilseeds in storage on an average date.
supuestos.perdida_cereal_anual.descripci: Annual loss of stored grain. In hermetic silos it is under 1%; with smallholders in the tropics, 18 to 36%.
supuestos.perros.descripcion: Owned dogs, the ones someone was feeding (there are 700 million to 1 billion dogs in total; over 70% are free-roaming).
supuestos.piso_silvestre.descripcion: What a tree gone wild still yields relative to year 1.
supuestos.poblacion_colmena.descripcion: Hive population according to John Cena's video (ep. 6).
supuestos.ratio_req_adultos.descripcion: Requirement of an adult (15-64) relative to the average.
supuestos.ratio_req_mayores.descripcion: Requirement of an elderly person (65+) relative to the average.
supuestos.ratio_req_ninos.derivacion: Weighted average of 0-4 (1,000) and 5-14 (1,740) = 1,503 kcal, divided by the population average of 2,072.
supuestos.ratio_req_ninos.descripcion: Requirement of a child (0-14) relative to the average.
supuestos.recuperacion_diaria.descripcio: Extra a malnourished person can eat per day to rebuild their reserve, as a fraction of their requirement.
supuestos.rendimiento_hdp.derivacion: Model assumption; the canon shows grinders, cooking vats and reconstituted powder.
supuestos.rendimiento_hdp.descripcion: Fraction of a body's energy that ends up as edible HDP (grinding, cooking, drying).
supuestos.reserva_mediana_adultos.deriva: Average of ~150,000 kcal (verification gives 131,000-160,000 when fat is recalculated at 13-15 kg); with sigma 0.6 the median is 150,000 / e^(0.6²/2) ≈ 125,000.
supuestos.reserva_mediana_adultos.descri: Median mobilizable body reserve of an adult before dying of starvation (usable fat plus half the protein).
supuestos.reserva_mediana_mayores.descri: Median reserve of an elderly person (65+): more fat, but less tolerance.
supuestos.reserva_mediana_ninos.derivaci: Assumption: 5-14 years, ~25 kg with 4-5 kg of usable fat; 0-4 years, ~12 kg.
supuestos.reserva_mediana_ninos.descripc: Median reserve of a child (0-14): from ~15,000 kcal in under-5s to ~35,000 in school-age children.
supuestos.reserva_sigma.derivacion: With sigma 0.6, the 5th percentile falls at ~42,000 kcal (underweight) and the 95th at ~300,000 (obesity).
supuestos.reserva_sigma.descripcion: Spread (lognormal sigma) of the reserves, from underweight (390 million adults) to obesity (890 million).
supuestos.riesgo_desnutricion_max.deriva: Midpoint between anchors that pull in opposite directions: at ~76% of the ration the model gives ~2.4% deaths in 12 months (Ethiopian refugees on 1,360-1,870 kcal: ~9%, but with epidemics, which the model doesn't have), and with extreme rations it is somewhat more lethal than Leningrad, where people ate more than the official bread ration.
supuestos.riesgo_desnutricion_max.descri: Daily risk of dying when the reserve nears zero (infections, organ failure). It grows with the square of the shortfall below the threshold.
supuestos.soya_mt.derivacion: Ending stocks + ~0.3 × production (125 + 0.3 × 429 ≈ 255 Mt), validated against US quarterly stocks.
supuestos.soya_mt.descripcion: Soybeans in storage on an average date of the year (ending stocks, 125 Mt, are the low point of the cycle).
supuestos.tuberculos_mt.descripcion: Potatoes in storage on an average date. Cassava doesn't count: it rots within 2-3 days out of the ground.
supuestos.umbral_desnutricion.derivacion: 30% of an adult's median reserve (~34,000 kcal) is equivalent to having lost ~28% of body weight: close to the WHO's BMI 16.
supuestos.umbral_desnutricion.descripcio: Reserve, relative to that of a typical person of the same age, below which the risk of dying from malnutrition begins: roughly severe thinness (BMI < 16). That's why those who were already thin die first.
tablas.cereal_en_mano_mt_por_mes.derivac: In-house model: USDA PSD 2025/26 by country × AMIS harvest calendar, with even consumption and a 0.85 factor calibrated against US quarterly stocks (NASS). The low falls on July 1 and the high on December 1.
tablas.cereal_en_mano_mt_por_mes.descrip: Cereal physically in storage worldwide on the 1st of each month (January to December).
tablas.cosecha_cereal_frac_por_mes.descr: Fraction of the world cereal harvest brought in each month.
tablas.fruta_caida_frac_por_mes.derivaci: 76% tropical (coconut, palm, banana: even all year) + 23% northern temperate (stone fruit Jun-Sep, apples Aug-Nov, nuts Aug-Oct, olives Oct-Feb) + 1% southern.
tablas.fruta_caida_frac_por_mes.descripc: Fraction of the year's windfall fruit that falls in each month.
